title: Project Management
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Ahora dominas el vocabulario clave para liderar y gestionar proyectos internacionales.

parts.visual:
Tiempos y Plazos: 
- Deadline (Fecha límite). 
- Milestone (Hito / Etapa importante). 
- Schedule (Cronograma). 
Ej: We must meet the deadline. The next milestone is in two weeks.
parts.audio: Time and deadlines. Deadline is the final date to finish something. Milestone is a very important stage in a project. Schedule is the plan for when things happen. For example: We must meet the deadline. The next milestone is in two weeks.

parts.visual:
Estado del proyecto: 
- On track (En camino / Según lo planeado). 
- Behind schedule (Atrasado). 
- Allocate resources (Asignar recursos). 
Ej: We are currently behind schedule, so we need to allocate more resources to get back on track.
parts.audio: Project status. On track means everything is going according to plan. Behind schedule means you are late. Allocate resources means to assign time, money, or people to a task. For example: We are currently behind schedule, so we need to allocate more resources to get back on track.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la palabra correcta de gestión de proyectos.

questions.question: Friday is the ____ for this report. We can't be late. (Fecha límite).
Reaching 10,000 users was a huge ____ for our startup. (Hito / Etapa clave).
Let me check the ____ to see when the meeting is. (Cronograma / Horario).
Good news! The project is exactly on ____. (En camino / Según lo planeado).
questions.explanation: On track = en camino, avanzando bien.

questions.question: We are two weeks behind ____. We need to work faster. (Atrasados en el cronograma).
We finished the task ahead of ____. We have extra time now! (Adelantados).
questions.explanation: Ahead of schedule = adelantado al plan.

questions.question: The manager needs to ____ more budget to the marketing team. (Asignar).
Our main ____ is a lack of developers. (Cuello de botella / Obstáculo).
questions.explanation: Bottleneck = cuello de botella (lo que retrasa un proceso).

questions.question: We must ____ the deadline, or the client will be angry. (Cumplir con la fecha).
questions.explanation: Meet a deadline = cumplir una fecha límite.

questions.question: I'm sorry, we are going to ____ the deadline. We need two more days. (Incumplir / Pasarse de la fecha).
questions.explanation: Miss a deadline = no cumplir con la fecha límite.

questions.question: Can you give me a status ____ on the project? (Actualización).
The ____ phase of the project is complete. Now we start building. (Planificación).
We need to set clear ____ for this quarter. (Objetivos / Metas).
Who is ____ charge of this project? (A cargo).
questions.explanation: In charge of = a cargo de.

questions.question: We are running ____ of budget. We need to cut costs. (Quedándonos sin).
questions.explanation: Run out of = quedarse sin (dinero, tiempo).

questions.question: Please ____ sure everyone knows what to do. (Asegurarse).
What is the ____ of the project? (Alcance).
questions.explanation: Scope = el alcance (qué incluye y qué no incluye el proyecto).

questions.question: We need to delegate some ____ to the junior team. (Tareas).
The project was completely successful. It was a great ____. (Logro).
Let's organize a ____ meeting to start the project. (Reunión inicial).
questions.explanation: Kick-off meeting = reunión de inicio o lanzamiento.

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la palabra de gestión de proyectos.

questions.question: The project ____. (Fecha límite con D)
An important ____. (Hito con M)
Check the ____. (Cronograma con S)
We are on ____. (En camino con T)
We are behind ____. (Atrasados - palabra larga con S)
To ____ resources. (Asignar con A)
A status ____. (Actualización con U)
The project ____. (Alcance con S)
To ____ a deadline. (Cumplir con M)
To ____ a deadline. (Incumplir con M)
